A medium, indoor shot shows an older adult woman with fair skin and gray-silver, long, straight hair styled back, wearing glasses, a dark gray V-neck top, and a light beige cardigan. Her oval face has soft lines, a well-defined contour, and a medium forehead. Her medium-sized, almond-shaped eyes with slightly droopy upper eyelids have dark irises. Her medium-thick eyebrows are well-defined with a subtle arch. She has a straight, medium-sized nose with a smooth, symmetrical bridge. Her medium-thick lips have slightly upturned corners forming a subtle smile, revealing aligned, complete, natural teeth. Visible ears are proportionate to her face, adorned with medium-sized gold hoop earrings. A short to medium neck displays a chain with a small circular pendant. Her straight, slightly back shoulders are visible. Her hands rest on a wooden countertop in front of her.

The countertop holds various food items arranged symmetrically: a wooden cutting board with raw meat, a small wooden bowl of brown grains, a glass of white liquid, green pumpkin seeds in a small wooden bowl, a red bell pepper, a green apple, a red apple, half an avocado, and red strawberries in a small wooden bowl, with yellow bananas extending from behind.

Behind the woman is a slightly blurred kitchen with beige tiled walls and two wooden shelves holding terracotta and ceramic bowls, jars, potted green plants, and a dark mortar and pestle. Soft, diffused light comes from the front-left, and the camera is at face level.
